items.title: The Gaza health ministry updates the total Palestinian casualties to 72,549 killed and 172,274 injured, including at least 773 killed and 2,171 injured since the October 2025 ceasefire.
Turkey reports a record 318 deaths in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 35,926.
The Department of Health and Social Care reports 5,526 new confirmed cases and 888 more deaths from COVID-19, bringing the United Kingdom's death toll to 15,464 and 114,217 total cases.
Aid starts to flow in after an earthquake kills over 270 people in Ecuador.

President of China Hu Jintao visits survivors in the earthquake zone as the death toll climbs to more than 1,700 people.
Iraq: Four bombings occur in Baghdad, killing at least 198 in the April 18, 2007 Baghdad bombings.
